title: See What the Repo Adds to My Codex Session

steps.intent: start a new Codex tab in Explorer Project, and in the Runes panel choose a vault card and press Start Session, without sending a message
if Vidar asks whether to trust this folder, find that prompt and trust it
open Runes in that tab and find the skills that come from the repo itself, and whether they are on or off
find the repo's own Codex settings files listed in the Runes panel
